t: Key Vocabulary of Photosynthetic Crop Efficiency Enhancement
title: Key Vocabulary of Photosynthetic Crop Efficiency Enhancement
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Six terms unlock the whole database. chassis: a well-characterized host organism used as a platform for engineered functions. bioreactor: a vessel that maintains the conditions cells need to grow and produce. titer: the concentration of product a process achieves. downstream processing: the purification steps after the biological production step. biosafety level: the graded containment standard matched to organism risk. feedstock: the raw material input a biological process converts. The glossary program below looks up any of these terms instantly; use it while reading the other records.
